name: TheFinestBakehouse
description: A luxury, faith-forward cottage food bakery brand 'TheFinestBakehouse' based in Maryland. Founded by Sydni, it specializes in bespoke luxury cakes, $35/dozen gourmet cupcakes, and artisanal cookies. The aesthetic is high-end, warm luxury editorial. Key values: Baked with intention, Served with love, Faith-led passion.
